class.name: GaussianSplatRegionOverride
class.brief_description: Runtime tint, emission, opacity, wind and shadow controls for a baked splat region.
class.description: Assign this resource with [method GaussianSplatWorld3D.set_region_override] or [method GaussianSplatNode3D.set_region_override]. The CPU stores float values; emission and opacity are packed to half precision on GPU upload. Emissive components are clamped to the fp16 maximum, 65504, on upload; the Resource retains its float values. Volume region IDs are NOT stable across edits. Game code must resolve regions by name through [method GaussianSplatWorld3D.get_region_id] or [method GaussianSplatNode3D.get_region_id], never use hard-coded numeric IDs. Region 0 is the whole-asset default, inherited by regions without an explicit override. Overrides stay resident across payload eviction and apply to every LOD.

members.member: Blend from the SH color to [member tint], clamped to 0 to 1 on upload.
Emission added after direct and ambient lighting. Components are clamped to 0 to 65504 on GPU upload.
Opacity multiplier, clamped to 0 to 1 on upload. Zero hides the region before sort allocation and suppresses its shadow.
If false, forces the splat wind weight to zero, including its weighted positional effector response.
If false, suppresses this region's shadow while keeping its color visible.
Blends the tinted SH color halfway toward yellow before lighting.
